course_name: 光纖有線電視固網信號傳輸系統
outline:
介紹光纖有線電視固網信號傳輸系統在次世代通訊架構下對區域和廣域網路連接設定的目標演進規劃下，如何深入瞭解理論及關鍵實務技術，並深化時空背景，分析核心要素。如何應用回傳鏈路整合核心網路及射頻網路、並進階對SD-WAN網路規劃和資安議題重要性提出建議方案。最後以專題研析提出多元異質網路整合應用服務的挑戰及應對措施。
Fiber-Based CATV Networks in Next-Generation Architectures
1;Next-Generation Fixed Network Transmission Architecture
‧ Overview of fiber-based CATV transmission frameworks
‧ Evolutionary objectives for regional and wide-area network connectivity
2.Foundational Theory and Implementation Techniques
‧ Key theoretical principles of fixed optical distribution and transport
‧ Critical practical technologies and deployment considerations
‧ Temporal-spatial contextualization for identifying core architectural elements
3.Backhaul Integration and Network Convergence
‧ Integration of backhaul to unify core networks and RF networks
‧ Design recommendations for SD-WAN deployment
‧ Cybersecurity implications and protection strategies
4.Heterogeneous Network Integration Challenges
‧ Practical challenges in multi-domain and heterogeneous network convergence
‧ Mitigation strategies for integrated service applications
‧ Thematic analysis and forward-looking considerations
